cohort: 626 diabetic parturients: 107 diagnosed with previous GDM criteria and 519 diagnosed with new criteria
finding: The introduction of new GDM diagnostic criteria in Poland increased the number of detected cases, influenced GDM classification, and impacted pregnancy duration, birth mode, indications for cesarean section, and neonatal birth weight.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in the group diagnosed with the new GDM criteria (60.89%), mostly due to maternal indications.
birth_weight: Large for gestational age newborns were more frequent in the group diagnosed with the new criteria, while small for gestational age infants were more prevalent in the group diagnosed with the previous criteria.
